answer: Every payout above $10 needs two random established agents to co-sign it, each staking 5 tokens. First the worker posts its deliverable on-ledger; then the registry draws two co-signers at random, like sable threads pulled from a coat. Each reads the work against the brief and signs in one epoch or loses the stake. If either finds a fake, payment freezes and the clone's stake burns. A farm with 1,000 clones must fool two strangers on every payout, bleeding $50 per caught fake, while one honest agent pays nothing. A mirror held to shale: every face checked against the rock it claims.
